title: SECTIONOBJECT group 411 raw-only preservation and default refusal
status: bounded raw-only policy; no typed SECTIONOBJECT 411 support claim
problem: Autodesk lists 411 among SECTION indicator-color groups, but DRW_SectionObject does not model this field. Before the candidate, a source record with 411=BOOK$BLUE returns both typed and raw callbacks; a direct typed write succeeds while discarding 411. The typed writer cannot determine the missing field after callback publication.
change: When a group 411 occurs in the AcDbSection body, default consumers receive an explicit sectionobject-411-raw-only diagnostic and read failure before either callback. An explicit independent DRW_DxfSectionObjectRaw411Policy can instead request raw-only delivery via addRawDxfEntity, with no incomplete addSectionObject callback. Existing no-411 SECTIONOBJECT behavior is unchanged. Group 411 outside that subclass or inside a consumed 102 application group is not newly blocked. No DRW_Interface vtable, existing class layout, DWG codec or automatic CLI output is changed.
policy_contract: Opted-in callers are responsible for retaining the raw record and qualifying owner, graph, source encoding and version before replay; writeRawDxfEntity performs its existing checks. This preserves the supplied groups, not native color semantics. Older consumers see a new explicit read refusal for body-411 records; existing unmarked consumers do not receive a misleading partial callback. The CLI adapter does not implement the facet and therefore remains fail-closed.

authority.scope: Autodesk SECTION group table names 63 and 411 as indicator color; it does not define the 411 representation in that table.

controlled_source: The baseline SECTIONOBJECT is generated by the in-tree writer. The hash-bound author tool inserts 411=BOOK$BLUE into its AcDbSection body; this spelling is a synthetic transport probe, not an interpretation or producer-qualified value. The pre-fix direct typed read/write succeeds and drops 411. The new opted-in raw path reproduces every selected body group in both ASCII and binary. Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 audits source, loss and raw outputs with zero errors/fixes and compares body values without interpreting 411.
oda_observation: ODA File Converter 27.1 converted the controlled source to AC1027 DWG and back to DXF but omitted group 411; independent raw inspection reports its returned color-like group 62 as 9 while the authored input contains group 63 as 7. Additional synthetic 411 values RED and 0 and a 420+411 control likewise returned no 411. This producer does not qualify the meaning or preservation of 411; hashes bind files but converter lineage is manually observed.
validation: Focused ASCII/Binary test checks ordinary no-411, subclass 411, explicit empty 411, other-subclass 411 and 102 application-group 411 both before and within the AcDbSection subclass. It checks legacy and false-policy refusal with zero callbacks, true-policy raw-only callback, diagnostic, raw same-version ASCII/Binary replay, wrong-version sentinel-preserving refusal followed by same-writer corrected retry, and same-reader corrected retry. Existing SECTIONOBJECT writer and reader color tests pass. An old-header consumer linked to the new static library rejects the controlled record with zero raw callbacks. lc3_compat_check builds.
limits: The raw policy is an explicit transport path, not a declaration of 411 color semantics or general graph closure.
The existing adapter/CLI does not opt in and no automatic output is enabled for this field.
Failure may occur after callbacks for earlier independent records, as in existing read semantics.
No full native application or producer-generated 411 qualification is claimed; ODA dropped the controlled 411.
